projectDescription: The CocoaPods Master Specs Repo is the centralized registry of over 100,000 public iOS and macOS library podspecs, served via CDN for dependency resolution.
keyFeatures: Centralized registry of 100,000+ iOS and macOS library podspecs
CDN-backed delivery for fast dependency resolution worldwide
Sharded index for efficient pod lookup by name prefix
CocoaPods Trunk integration for publishing (no PRs accepted)
Supports pod deprecation and deletion via trunk CLI
Algolia-powered search index for pod discovery
Automated nightly PR closure to enforce trunk-only submissions
Podspec JSON format with versioned entries per pod
publicApiSurface: CDN endpoint: all_pods.txt — full list of pod names
CDN endpoint: all_pods_versions_{shard}.txt — sharded pod/version index
CDN endpoint: deprecated_podspecs.txt — list of deprecated podspecs
CDN endpoint: CocoaPods-version.yml — minimum and latest CocoaPods version
pod trunk push — publish a new pod version
pod trunk delete — remove a pod version
pod trunk deprecate — mark a pod as deprecated
